variants.name: Контур
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one standalone macOS application icon concept for Menu Bar Dock, square composition, one centered anchor. The reference image is ONLY to identify the anchor symbol: circular eye, crossbar, central shank, two upward flukes. Completely discard its turquoise and purple colors and heavy outline. The user rejected a bright glossy candy-colored 3D result and wants a more serious, restrained professional utility icon. Refine the anchor geometry for excellent small-size legibility, balanced optical weight, crisp deliberate curves and generous breathing room. Rounded-square macOS tile occupying 84 percent of the square canvas; anchor occupies about 58 percent of canvas. Straight-on symmetric composition. Transparent outside the tile. No neon, purple, cyan, rainbow, colorful gradient, glossy plastic, puffy inflatable shapes, glow, sparkles, ornamental nautical ropes, extra symbols, letters, labels, text or watermarks. Deliver the icon alone, not a poster, not a board, not a screenshot. Direction 1: precise outline. Warm off-white matte tile (#F2F1EE), graphite charcoal line anchor (#292D31). Elegant disciplined geometric monoline design, medium-bold uniform stroke, gently squared rounded line endings. The eye is a clear circle and the flukes are drawn as clean open strokes, not arrowheads. Flat two-tone design with no shading, no shadow inside the icon. A compact and quiet technical drawing aesthetic, unmistakably an anchor.
